ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.
   C. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

3. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad.
   C. Say Ijtihad has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ijtihad to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq .
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.
   C. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.
   D. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.
   C. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues 3.2 Prohibitions in Islam 4.0 Islamic History and Civilisation 4.1Abbasi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Abbasid Dynasty 4.2 Fatimid Dynasty 4.3 Islam in Africa 4.4 Influence of Islam i and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. A — Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
